title: Programming with LLMs

description-short: Advanced LLM programming techniques
duration: 55min

## Slides

{{< revealjs "slides/slides-04.html" class="ratio ratio-16x9" >}}

## Outline

- (15m) Providers and models
  - Overview of providers and models
  - Tradeoffs: context, speed, cost, intelligence, and capabilities
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/07_models`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/07_models): compare responses from two models

- (15m) Multimodal input
  - Images and PDFs from local files and URLs
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/08_vision`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/08_vision): show images of food to an LLM
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/09_pdf`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/09_pdf): convert a recipe PDF to Markdown

- (15m) Structured output
  - `ellmer::type_*()` and [Pydantic models in chatlas](https://posit-dev.github.io/chatlas/get-started/structured-data.html)
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/10_structured-output`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/10_structured-output): extract structured recipe data

- (10m) Parallel and batch calls
  - Differences between parallel requests and provider batch APIs
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/11_parallel`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/11_parallel): extract all recipes in parallel and open them in the recipe app
